desc:
Each bite delivers a burst of delicious Cola flavour that's irresistibly moreish. Individually wrapped inside each stick, these chews are made with real fruit juice, contain no artificial colours, and are suitable for vegetarians.

Chewits · Multipack
ingredients:
Cola Flavour Chewy Sweets.

Ingredients: glucose syrup, sugar, vegetable fats (palm, coconut), acids (lactic acid, citric acid), concentrate from (carrot, apple, hibiscus, molasses, blackcurrant), flavouring, EGG white powder, hydrolysed pea protein.
